name: SakiMaki! Shiro Ecchi na White Version Bijin Shimai Kyoushi no Taiatari Jissen Kyouiku Hen
original_name: サキマキ!白 エッチなホワイトバージョン 美人姉妹教師の体当たり実践教育編
source:
Sakimaki! White - The lewd tale of beautiful sister teachers wrapped in the lust of naughty male students.

Saki and Maki are beloved teachers who worked at the same school.
Saki the nurse and health officer gets off with a boy in the clinic, then hooks up with the volleyball team...
Younger Maki works the classrooms, with youngsters who satisfy her where her boyfriend is lacking...
